channel.title: Home.Watch guides
channel.description: Guides for homes that sit empty.

item.title: What Is Home Watch? The Complete Guide for Absentee Homeowners
item.description: Home watch explained: what a home watcher checks, who needs the service, how visits and reports work, and how it differs from security monitoring.

item.title: How Much Does Home Watch Cost? Pricing, Visit Frequency and What to Expect
item.description: Typical home watch prices by visit frequency and home size, how providers structure fees, the add-ons that raise the bill and how to compare quotes fairly.

item.title: How to Choose a Home Watch Provider: 21 Questions to Ask
item.description: The questions that separate professional home watch companies from casual helpers: insurance, bonding, background checks, reports, response times and contracts.

item.title: The Snowbird Departure Checklist: Closing Your Home for the Season
item.description: A room-by-room checklist for closing a seasonal home: water, climate, power, security, insurance, mail and the final walk-through before you leave.

item.title: Vacant Home Insurance and Vacancy Clauses: What Absentee Owners Need to Know
item.description: How homeowners policies treat vacant and unoccupied homes, the 30- and 60-day conditions to watch for, and how regular inspections and documentation help.

item.title: Preventing Frozen Pipes in an Empty Home
item.description: Why pipes burst in vacant homes, the thermostat and water settings that prevent it, when to winterize, which sensors help and what to do after a freeze.

item.title: Hurricane Season Plan for Absentee Homeowners
item.description: How to prepare a coastal home you will not be in during hurricane season: shutters, documentation, insurance, who acts when a storm forms and post-storm checks.

item.title: Water Leak Detection and Smart Shutoff Valves Explained
item.description: How spot leak sensors, flow monitors and automatic shutoff valves work, where to put them, what they cost to install and their limits in an empty home.

item.title: Humidity and Mold in a Closed-Up Home: Settings That Work
item.description: How to keep a seasonal home dry in hot, humid climates: thermostat and humidity targets, dehumidifiers, airflow, and early signs of mold your home watcher should catch.

item.title: Smart Home Monitoring for Second Homes: Sensors, Cameras and Connectivity
item.description: Build a practical remote-monitoring kit for a vacation or seasonal home: what to monitor, Wi-Fi versus cellular, power backup, privacy and who responds to alerts.

item.title: Home Watch vs. Property Management vs. House Sitting: Which Do You Need?
item.description: Compare home watch, property management, house sitting and concierge services by cost, responsibility, insurance and the kind of home they suit.

item.title: Returning Home: The Re-Opening Checklist
item.description: What to do when you arrive back at a seasonal home: safe water and power restart, HVAC, pests, appliances, security and what to report to your home watcher.

item.title: Starting a Home Watch Business: Licensing, Insurance, Pricing and First Clients
item.description: A practical overview for launching a home watch business: registration, insurance and bonding, checklists and reports, pricing, software and finding clients.

item.title: Protecting a Vacant Home From Break-ins and Squatters
item.description: How burglars and squatters spot empty homes, the lived-in signals that deter them, physical and electronic security, and what to do if someone moves in.
